title: 第23章 师兄师姐早生贵子第24章 荒林枯井玄天战镜1
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
此时正是清晨，天光明媚，林间回响着弟子们切磋的呼喊和轰鸣声，天空云雾舒展，依稀可见灵鸟振翅，灵舟飞掠。
周元关闭禁制，沿着小路离开。刚到拐角处，竟看到了旁边洞府开门而出的苏珂。
两个月没见，苏师姐越发明媚了，阳光照在白皙的肌肤上，好似发着光，娇媚的模样，让秀丽山林都黯然失色。纤细的腰肢和丰满的胯部，形成了迷人的曲线，美妙到让人窒息。
她身后还站着一个黑脸男人，正是周庭。
住一块了啊。
看来真成亲了。
只是苏珂看起来明媚动人，更有韵味了，周庭反倒像是消瘦了很多，状态不佳，眼神里没了光亮。
这种感觉他熟悉。
宋奎！
想当年那恶霸刚把齐寡妇娶回家的时候，兴奋地像是头公牛，夜里能让齐寡妇叫三回。过了没多久，就跟霜打的茄子似得，蔫吧了。
周庭现在状态跟宋奎当时几乎一样。
他懂。
这是消耗过大了。
齐寡妇那样的，宋奎都一夜三回。
苏珂这样蜜汁满满的身材，千娇百媚的模样，清冷孤傲的气质，周庭不得七回？
洞府隔音效果就是好，他竟然一点声儿都没听到。
周元心里坏坏想着，脸上却是露出欣喜之色，主动行礼：“苏师姐，好久不见。周师兄，恭喜啊。”
“周元？”
苏珂差点没认出来。
五官还是那个五官，进宗都两个月了，皮肤还是有些病态的蜡黄，隐隐透着股虚弱感。可那身补丁粗衣换成合体的黑袍后，整个人好像都变了样。

身姿挺拔，眉目俊朗，一身黑袍映衬出韧劲和清爽。
感觉就像是粗陶剥落了尘泥，露出底下温润的胎骨，让她竟有种眼前一亮的感觉。
周庭看到周元，眼底泛起抹异样，嘴角挣扎着蠕动，想说什么，却终究还是没有说出口。
“师姐，听说你跟周师兄成亲了，恭喜你寻得良人。”周元没注意到周庭欲言又止的神情，只当是想炫耀，又不合时宜，憋得难受，便没在意，继续向苏师姐表达着祝贺。
“可惜啊，你不在。”苏珂越看周元越觉着满意，这小子果然跟她之前想的那样俊俏，而且无父无母无背景，正是做遮掩的完美人选。
“我出去做任务了，还跟周师兄打过招呼呢。”周元朝着周庭点头示意，眼角含笑，你这一百颗灵石花的值了吧，相当于买了个媳妇。
“……”周庭嘴角蠕动，眼神悲戚。一百颗灵石是买了个媳妇，但特么的是买一送一，还只可远观，不可亵玩！外人面前，还要装恩爱！
“做什么任务了。”苏珂似笑非笑的看着周元，分明是被赶跑了，装的跟真的似的。
“想挖地元参的。”
“挖到了吗？”
“没那命。”周元苦笑着摇头。
“如果哪天挖到地元参，可以上缴奎阆山，算贡献值的。”
“灵药还算贡献值？”周元诧异的扬起头。
“很多灵药都能算贡献值的。”苏珂点着纤细的手指，罗列了十几种灵药。
“谢师姐指点！”
周元没想到宝药还能换贡献，而且药龄越高，贡献值越大。这样他岂不是不用出去冒险，交给地髓石就好了。
“我要去玄青谷，要不要一起？”
“我还是不打扰你们了。祝苏师姐和周师兄幸福顺遂，早生贵子。”周元再次表达了真诚的祝贺。
“呜……”周庭像是心窝子被捅了一刀子，嘴角猛地抿紧，差点哭出来。
“周师兄这是……”

“已经有了。”苏珂轻抚腹部，脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容。
“啊？周师兄厉害啊！”周元很是钦佩，要知道宋奎折腾了三年都没让齐寡妇下个蛋，周庭不到两个月就做到了。
果然，凡事多努力，大力出奇迹。
七次就比三次强。
云下九山并不是聚在一起的，而是分散各个区域。最强的首阳山居于正中，地位较弱的奎阆山则位于灵宗偏南，已经属于外围。
content_en:
It was early in the morning, the sky was bright, and the forest echoed with the shouts and roars of the disciples competing. The clouds and mist in the sky spread, and you could vaguely see spiritual birds flapping their wings and spiritual boats flying by.
Zhou Yuan closed the restriction and left along the path. As soon as he reached the corner, he saw Su Ke opening the door of the cave next to him.
After not seeing each other for two months, Senior Sister Su is getting brighter and brighter. The sun shines on her fair skin, which seems to be glowing. Her charming appearance makes the beautiful mountains and forests eclipse her. The slender waist and plump crotch form charming curves that are so beautiful that you will take your breath away.
There was a dark-faced man standing behind her, it was Zhou Ting.
Let's live together.
It looks like they are really married.
It's just that Su Ke looks bright and charming, but Zhou Ting seems to have lost a lot of weight, is in poor condition, and has no light in his eyes.
This feeling was familiar to him.
Song Kui!
I remember when the bully first married Widow Qi home, he was as excited as a bull and could make Widow Qi bark three times at night. After a while, it became as wilted as an eggplant beaten by frost.
Zhou Ting's current state is almost the same as Song Kui's at that time.
He understands.
This is too much consumption.
Widow Qi was like that, Song Kui did it three times a night.
With Su Ke's juicy figure, charming appearance, and cold and aloof temperament, Zhou Ting couldn't return seven times?
The soundproofing effect of the cave was so good that he didn't hear a sound at all.
Zhou Yuan was thinking evilly in his heart, but with a look of joy on his face, he took the initiative to salute: "Senior Sister Su, long time no see. Senior Brother Zhou, congratulations."
"Zhou Yuan?"
Su Ke almost didn't recognize it.
His facial features are still the same. It has been two months since he joined the sect, and his skin is still a bit sickly and sallow, with a faint feeling of weakness. But after the patched rough clothes were replaced by a fitted black robe, his whole person seemed to have changed.
He has a tall and straight posture, handsome eyebrows, and a black robe that reflects his tenacity and freshness.
It felt like the dust and mud had been peeled off from rough pottery, revealing the warm fetal bones underneath, which made her feel like her eyes were brightening.
When Zhou Ting saw Zhou Yuan, something strange appeared in his eyes, and the corners of his mouth wriggled, trying to say something, but in the end he still couldn't.
"Senior Sister, I heard that you and Senior Brother Zhou are getting married. Congratulations on finding your sweetheart." Zhou Yuan didn't notice Zhou Ting's hesitant expression. He just thought it was because he wanted to show off, but it was inappropriate and uncomfortable to hold back, so he didn't care and continued to express his congratulations to Senior Sister Su.
"It's a pity that you're not here." The more Su Ke looked at Zhou Yuan, the more satisfied she felt. This boy was indeed as handsome as she thought before, and he had no father, mother or background, so he was the perfect candidate to cover up.
"I went out to do a mission, and I even said hello to Senior Brother Zhou." Zhou Yuan nodded towards Zhou Ting with a smile in his eyes. Isn't your hundred spirit stone flowers worth it? It's equivalent to buying a daughter-in-law.
"..." The corners of Zhou Ting's mouth twitched and his eyes were sad. One hundred spirit stones bought me a daughter-in-law, but what the hell is buy one get one free, you can only watch from a distance, not play with it! You have to pretend to be affectionate in front of outsiders!
"What mission are you doing?" Su Ke looked at Zhou Yuan with a half-smile but not a smile. He was clearly driven away, pretending to be serious.
"I want to dig up ginseng."
"Did you dig it?"
"No such fate." Zhou Yuan smiled bitterly and shook his head.
"If you dig up Diyuan Ginseng one day, you can hand it over to Kuilang Mountain and it will be counted as a contribution."
"Does the elixir still count as a contribution?" Zhou Yuan raised his head in surprise.
"Many elixirs can be counted as contribution points." Su Ke pointed his slender fingers and listed a dozen elixirs.
"Thank you, senior sister, for your advice!"
Zhou Yuan did not expect that the precious medicine could be exchanged for contribution, and the older the medicine, the greater the contribution value. Wouldn't it be better if he didn't have to go out to take risks and just leave it to the Earth Marrow Stone?
"I'm going to Xuanqing Valley, do you want to come with me?"
"I won't bother you anymore. I wish Senior Sister Su and Senior Brother Zhou happiness and good luck in having a son soon." Zhou Yuan once again expressed his sincere congratulations.
"Ugh..." Zhou Ting felt as if he had been stabbed in the heart, and the corners of his mouth suddenly twitched.Squeezing it tight, I almost cried.
"Senior Brother Zhou, this is..."
"Already." Su Ke caressed his abdomen, with a happy smile on his face.
"Ah? Senior Brother Zhou is awesome!" Zhou Yuan admired him very much. You must know that Song Kui struggled for three years without getting Widow Qi to lay an egg, and Zhou Ting did it in less than two months.
Sure enough, if you work harder, miracles will happen.
Seven times is better than three times.
The Nine Mountains under the Cloud are not gathered together, but scattered in various areas. The strongest Shouyang Mountain is located in the center, while the weaker Kuilang Mountain is located to the south of Lingzong and is already on the periphery.
